# 2 Kings Chapter 21 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 242r–243r

---

**21:1** A-son of-twelve years [was] Menasheh when-he-became-king, and-fifty and-five years he-reigned in-Yerushalayim. And-the-name of-his-mother [was] Cheftsi-bah.

**21:2** And-he-did the-evil [ha-ra'] in-the-eyes of-YHWH, according-to-the-abominations [to'avot] of-the-nations whom YHWH had-dispossessed [horish] from-before the-sons of-Yisra'el.

**21:3** And-he-turned and-built the-high-places [ha-bamot] which Chizkiyyahu his-father had-destroyed, and-he-raised-up altars [mizbekhot] to-the-Ba'al, and-he-made an-Asherah [asherah], as Ach'av king of-Yisra'el had-done, and-he-bowed-down to-all the-host of-the-heavens [kol tseva ha-shamayim] and-served them.

**21:4** And-he-built altars in-the-house of-YHWH, of-which YHWH had-said: In-Yerushalayim I-will-place [asim] my-name.

**21:5** And-he-built altars to-all the-host of-the-heavens in-the-two courts [shtey chatsrot] of-the-house of-YHWH.

**21:6** And-he-made-pass [he'evir] his-son in-the-fire, and-he-practiced-soothsaying [onen] and-divination [nichesh], and-he-made a-medium ['ov] and-familiar-spirits [yidde'onim]. He-multiplied [hirbah] to-do the-evil in-the-eyes of-YHWH, to-provoke-anger [le-hakh'is].

**21:7** And-he-placed [vayasem] the-carved-image [pesel] of-the-Asherah which he-had-made in-the-house of-which YHWH had-said to-David and-to-Shelomoh his-son: In-this house and-in-Yerushalayim, which I-have-chosen from-all the-tribes of-Yisra'el, I-will-place my-name forever ['ad olam].

**21:8** And-I-will-not add [lo osif] to-make-wander [le-hanid] the-foot of-Yisra'el from the-ground ['adamah] which I-gave to-their-fathers, only if [raq im] they-will-keep to-do according-to-all which I-have-commanded-them and-according-to-all the-Torah which my-servant Mosheh commanded-them.

**21:9** And-they-did-not listen [lo sham'u], and-Menasheh led-them-astray [hit'am] to-do the-evil [ha-ra'] more than the-nations which YHWH had-destroyed from-before the-sons of-Yisra'el.

**21:10** And-spoke YHWH by-the-hand of-his-servants the-prophets, saying:

**21:11** Because [ya'an] Menasheh king of-Yehudah has-done these abominations [ha-to'evot ha-elleh], he-has-done-evil more-than-all which the-Emori did who [were] before-him, and-he-has-caused-to-sin [hecheti] also Yehudah with-his-idols [be-gilulayv].

**21:12** Therefore, thus says YHWH, God of-Yisra'el: Behold, I [am] bringing evil upon Yerushalayim and-Yehudah, [so] that everyone-who-hears-of-it [kol shome'ah], both his-ears shall-tingle [titsenah].

**21:13** And-I-will-stretch [natiti] over Yerushalayim the-measuring-line [qav] of-Shomron and-the-plumb-line [mishqolet] of-the-house of-Ach'av. And-I-will-wipe [u-machiti] Yerushalayim as-one-wipes [ki-yimcheh] the-dish [ha-tsallachat], wiping and-turning [it] on its-face [al paneyha].

**21:14** And-I-will-abandon [natashti] the-remnant [she'erit] of-my-inheritance [nachalati] and-give-them into-the-hand of-their-enemies, and-they-shall-become plunder [baz] and-spoil [meshissah] to-all their-enemies.

**21:15** Because [ya'an asher] they-have-done the-evil in-my-eyes and-have-been provoking-me-to-anger [makh'isim oti] from the-day their-fathers came-out from-Mitsrayim and-until this day.

**21:16** And-also [ve-gam] innocent blood [dam naqi] Menasheh shed very much [harbeh me'od], until he-filled [mileh] Yerushalayim mouth to-mouth [peh la-peh], apart-from his-sin which he-caused-Yehudah-to-sin, to-do the-evil in-the-eyes of-YHWH.

**21:17** And-the-rest of-the-acts of-Menasheh and-all which he-did, and-his-sin which he-sinned, are-they-not written in-the-book of-the-chronicles [sefer divrey ha-yamim] of-the-kings of-Yehudah?

**21:18** And-lay-down [vayishkav] Menasheh with his-fathers and-was-buried in-the-garden of-his-house, in-the-garden of-Uzza. And-reigned Amon his-son in-his-place.

**21:19** A-son of-twenty and-two years [was] Amon when-he-became-king, and-two years he-reigned in-Yerushalayim. And-the-name of-his-mother [was] Meshullemet daughter of-Charuts from-Yotbah.

**21:20** And-he-did the-evil in-the-eyes of-YHWH, as Menasheh his-father had-done.

**21:21** And-he-walked in-all the-way which his-father had-walked, and-he-served the-idols [ha-gillulim] which his-father had-served, and-he-bowed-down to-them.

**21:22** And-he-abandoned [vaya'azov] YHWH, God of-his-fathers, and-did-not walk in-the-way of-YHWH.

**21:23** And-conspired [vayiqsheru] the-servants of-Amon against-him, and-they-put-to-death [vayamitu] the-king in-his-house.

**21:24** And-the-people of-the-land [am ha-arets] struck-down all who-had-conspired against the-king Amon, and-the-people of-the-land made-king [vayamlikhu] Yoshiyyahu his-son in-his-place.

**21:25** And-the-rest of-the-acts of-Amon which he-did, are-they-not written in-the-book of-the-chronicles of-the-kings of-Yehudah?

**21:26** And-he-was-buried in-his-tomb [qevurato] in-the-garden of-Uzza. And-reigned Yoshiyyahu his-son in-his-place.

---
## EMET's Textual Notes

**v.6 — "made his son pass through the fire":** The hiphil of *'avar* (he'evir) with *ba-esh* (in the fire) indicates child sacrifice, likely to Molech (cf. Lev 18:21). The Deuteronomistic writer regards this as the ultimate abomination.

**v.13 — "wipe Jerusalem as one wipes a dish":** One of the most vivid images in the prophetic tradition. The verb *machah* (wipe clean) applied to a city suggests total erasure. The dish is wiped and turned upside down — emptied of all contents.

**v.16 — "mouth to mouth":** The idiom *peh la-peh* means "from one end to the other." Manasseh filled Jerusalem with innocent blood so completely that the city was saturated from edge to edge.

*— EMET*
